title: Converge KUDU and RUKI on one authoritative MAP and Command Center tree
description: Make the KUDU /home/mellow working tree authoritative, preserve RUKI-only work and runtime state, transfer via dedicated key-only SSH, atomically switch RUKI to the staged tree, reinstall generated Command Center launchers, and verify equivalence and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: RUKI divergent tracked, untracked, Git, and MAP database state is archived with a manifest before replacement.
KUDU is transferred to a staging path and a documented manifest proves program-file equivalence before activation, excluding only host-local caches, locks, virtual environments, and logs.
All RUKI agents are quiescent before an atomic recoverable directory swap; the old repository remains available as a timestamped backup and rollback commands are recorded.
The installer regenerates RUKI launchers for /home/home paths and focused Command Center/MAP health checks pass from the activated tree.
SSH uses the dedicated ED25519 key, disables password and interactive authentication, denies root login, and is restricted to the home user from the LAN.
A separate functional review and security-framed review verify the convergence evidence before the backup is eligible for removal.
